## Terraform Provider for SAP Integration Suite v0.1.0

> **Known issue — use 0.2.0 or later.** This release cannot talk to SAP
> under Terraform. It builds its OAuth client with the context of the
> provider's configure call, which Terraform cancels as soon as that call
> returns, so every request fails with `context canceled` on the token URL.
> Only the feature catalog data sources, which send no request, work.

### Overview

The first release of the provider. It manages design-time content,
deployments and security material inside an existing SAP Integration Suite
tenant; the BTP subaccount, the subscription, service instances and role
assignments stay with the SAP BTP provider. It was built from SAP's
documentation and had not been run against a tenant.

### Resources and data sources

- **Cloud Integration content:** integration packages, integration flows,
  value mappings, message mappings, script collections and custom
  integration adapters, each with a separate `*_deployment` resource;
  service endpoint discovery; the tenant-wide custom tag configuration;
  number ranges.
- **Security:** access policies and references; user and OAuth2 client
  credentials with write-only secrets; certificates, SAP-generated key pairs
  and keystore entry lookups.
- **Partner Directory:** string and binary parameters, alternative
  partners, authorized users and user credential parameters, plus partner
  lookups.
- **Classic API Management** (separate `api_management` credentials): API
  providers, API products, certificate store references and key value maps.
- **Feature catalog:** `sapintegrationsuite_provider_feature(s)` data
  sources describe what the provider supports and why, without SAP
  credentials.

### Known limitations

- Several wire contracts were assumptions that turned out to be wrong on a
  tenant (access policy references, integration adapters, API products);
  0.2.0 corrects them.
- API proxies, certificate chains, secure parameters, known hosts and value
  mapping entries are not implemented.

### Compatibility

- Terraform 1.5 or later; 1.11 or later for resources with write-only
  secrets (`*_wo` attributes).
- Terraform plugin protocol 6.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Prideth/terraform-provider-sap-integration-suite/blob/dev/CHANGELOG.md)
for details.
